listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
Ancient Egypt was one of the world's first great civilizations.
It began about 5,000 years ago!
LOCATION:
Egypt is in Africa, along the NILE RIVER.
The Nile gave water for farming and transportation.
FAMOUS FEATURES:
1. PYRAMIDS - Giant tombs for pharaohs
The Great Pyramid of Giza is one of the 7 Wonders!
2. PHARAOHS - Kings of Egypt
Famous pharaoh: Tutankhamun (King Tut)
3. SPHINX - A statue with a lion's body and human head
4. HIEROGLYPHICS - Ancient Egyptian writing with pictures
5. MUMMIES - Preserved dead bodies
WHY IS IT IMPORTANT?
- Invented paper (papyrus)
- Built amazing architecture
- Developed mathematics and medicine
Ancient Egypt shows us how great civilizations can be!
dictation: Ancient Egypt was one of the world's first great civilizations.

LOCATION:
Egypt is in Africa, along the NILE RIVER.
